from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Fetching data from shared state
        title = "The 180-Degree Flip"
        lecture_lines = [
            "After a half-rotation, the line returns to its angle.",
            "However, the line is now oriented in reverse.",
            "Points originally on the left are now on the right.",
            "Every point must cross the line to swap sides.",
            "This proves the windmill hits every star eventually."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        BLUE_PT = "#0000FF"
        RED_PT = "#FF0000"
        GOLD_LINE = "#FFD700"
        GREEN_PT = "#00FF00"
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Show the initial balanced line with labeled sides and colored points
        
        # Using specific grid points for clear visual distribution
        pivot_pos = self.grid["D4"]
        pivot_dot = Dot(pivot_pos, color=WHITE, radius=0.1)
        
        # Left points (Blue) - positioned to be hit during rotation
        p1 = Dot(self.grid["B2"], color=BLUE_PT, radius=0.08)
        p2 = Dot(self.grid["C2"], color=BLUE_PT, radius=0.08)
        
        # Right points (Red)
        p3 = Dot(self.grid["E5"], color=RED_PT, radius=0.08)
        p4 = Dot(self.grid["F5"], color=RED_PT, radius=0.08)
        
        points = VGroup(pivot_dot, p1, p2, p3, p4)
        
        # Initial line (start pointing UP at PI/2)
        line = Line(pivot_pos + DOWN*3.5, pivot_pos + UP*3.5, color=GOLD_LINE, stroke_width=4)
        
        # Side labels
        label_l = Text("L", font_size=24, color=BLUE_PT)
        label_r = Text("R", font_size=24, color=RED_PT)
        
        # Manual positioning within 1 unit for consistency (relative to pivot center initially)
        label_l.move_to(pivot_pos + LEFT * 1.2)
        label_r.move_to(pivot_pos + RIGHT * 1.2)
        
        self.lecture[0].set_color(GOLD_LINE)
        self.play(FadeIn(points), Create(line), Write(label_l), Write(label_r))
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Rotate the line slowly 180 degrees using a 'smooth' rate function
        
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(GOLD_LINE)
        
        angle_tracker = ValueTracker(0)
        
        def line_updater(m):
            # Line rotates around pivot_pos
            # Angle PI/2 is vertical UP
            angle = PI/2 + angle_tracker.get_value()
            start = pivot_pos - 3.5 * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0])
            end = pivot_pos + 3.5 * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle), 0])
            m.put_start_and_end_on(start, end)
            
        def labels_updater(vgroup):
            # Move labels with the rotation to stay perpendicular to the line
            angle = PI/2 + angle_tracker.get_value()
            # Calculate normal vector (the "left" side relative to line direction)
            normal = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle), 0])
            vgroup[0].move_to(pivot_pos + normal * 1.2)
            vgroup[1].move_to(pivot_pos - normal * 1.2)
            
        labels_vgroup = VGroup(label_l, label_r)
        line.add_updater(line_updater)
        labels_vgroup.add_updater(labels_updater)
        
        # Perform 180-degree rotation (PI radians)
        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.set_value(PI), run_time=5, rate_func=smooth)
        self.wait(3.0)
        
        line.clear_updaters()
        labels_vgroup.clear_updaters()
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Morph the side labels and point colors to show the sides have completely swapped.
        
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(BLUE_PT)
        
        # Swap colors visually to represent the change in state
        # Points that were on the left (L/Blue) side of the line are now on the right side
        self.play(
            p1.animate.set_color(RED_PT),
            p2.animate.set_color(RED_PT),
            p3.animate.set_color(BLUE_PT),
            p4.animate.set_color(BLUE_PT),
            label_l.animate.set_color(RED_PT),
            label_r.animate.set_color(BLUE_PT),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(2.0)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Highlight each point in sequence as the line passes through it during the rotation.
        
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(GOLD_LINE)
        
        # Indicate points in order of being 'visited' by the line
        # Use Indicate as per L004
        self.play(Indicate(p2, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Indicate(p1, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Indicate(p3, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Indicate(p4, color=GOLD_LINE))
        self.wait(1.5)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Flash all points in green (#00FF00) to signify the proof is complete.
        
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(GREEN_PT)
        
        # Final flourish
        self.play(
            *[Flash(p, color=GREEN_PT) for p in points],
            *[p.animate.set_color(GREEN_PT) for p in points],
            run_time=2
        )
        
        self.wait(2.0)
